property_kinds.rust: PropertyKind::Fixed with immutable nonzero issued supply and conservation; no ticker/metadata. JS raw addProperty can increase/reclassify existing Fixed; Rust rejects duplicate creation and fixed Mint/Burn.

PropertyKind::Managed supports authorized exact-atom grant and issuer self-burn. JS helper methods are unguarded and non-atomic; ordinary high-level managed intent broadly aligns. Token backup/admin changes and catalog absent.

SourceCatalogClass::Native is catalog role metadata on NativeEntitlementPolicy, not a PropertyKind. Policy adopts independently pinned existing funding into sole Ledger, does not mint declarations or authenticate source history/schedule.

SourceCatalogClass::Vesting and coupon/marker bindings exist on native owner; underlying Ledger remains Fixed/Managed. Source-quote-exact-or-reject, prefunding, driver policy and event replay are explicit bounded policies, not general property catalog or exact genesis restoration.

VaultRegistry supports typed s-property-contract names, links and accounting calculations only; no synthetic PropertyKind or integrated property metadata/issuance/redemption. types_economic mapper excludes24/25.
No NFT PropertyKind, per-unit identity or NFT issuance owner. Source property.js stores only numeric type6 and supply; stronger NFT semantics are not inferred from that label.

No type7/proceduralType Ledger/catalog owner. JS Logic and validity gate issuance/redemption through ProceduralRegistry; holder context redemption may bypass managed-admin check. Mapper rejects DLC/procedural context; not equivalent to ordinary Managed.
